source_message.text:
Adjust anything that needs changing, but the FAQ section is as follows:

What exactly is Project Rebuild?
Project Rebuild serves as the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — the first system enabling indie creators to sell unlimited NFT ebooks while paying readers real commissions + prizes for spreading them.
It is launching on Base with my raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal,".
It is also my public mission to rebuild my family's life after a seed-phrase wipeout cost us millions.
If FAMM proves itself, Project Rebuild will develop into BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform available to every creator.

In what ways can buyers make money?
1. Receive an instant $5 commission whenever someone mints using your referral code
2. Get Small & Big Block prize tickets each time someone mints with your code
3. ***If FAMM is shown to be successful, and there is zero guarantee of success or value***, a future BooksOnChain governance token allocation will go to buyers, affiliates, and tippers of "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal,".

How does the referral process work?
For every NFT, its mint number IS the permanent referral code.
Both of these examples work perfectly:
→ Send your complete link
→ Or simply tell someone, “use referral 423”
As soon as someone mints with your code, you instantly receive $5 + Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.
→ When no referral code is entered during minting, the commission and tickets go to a random existing NFT holder.

Where can I locate my referral code?
Your referral code is your mint number, and it appears:
- Directly on your NFT
- Inside the NFT metadata
- On your Dashboard once you have minted
- In the confirmation email (optional)

How do Small Block and Big Block prizes work?
Small Block: 5 × $500 prizes are drawn every ~500 sales (mint + secondary)
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 prizes are drawn every ~50,000 sales (mint + secondary)
Every sale continues funding the pools forever.

What method is used to choose winners?
Chainlink VRF handles selection fully on-chain, making it provably fair and verifiable on Basescan.

What do Small & Big Block prize tickets represent?
They are entries into the current Small & Big Block prize drawings.
You earn tickets by having people mint with your code (1 Small + 1 Big per successful referral).
The more tickets you hold, the more opportunities you have to win.
After a block is drawn, its tickets expire, and new referrals apply toward the next blocks.

How can I collect my rewards?
- $5 commissions → transferred automatically to your wallet
- Prize wins → posted on the Winners page and claimable with one click here on [URL_009]

What purpose do badges serve?
On-chain badges are added to your NFT when you reach referral milestones (2, 10, 50, 100+).
For now, they are cosmetic + leaderboard flex.
In the future, they may unlock any number of things, including token-gated chats, discounts, etc.

Can I use fiat (credit card) to mint?
Yes — Transak accepts cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

Is a wallet required to participate?
No, you do not need one when minting with fiat.
However, you do need a wallet if you want to receive commissions, hold prize tickets, or later sell/trade the NFT.

Which blockchain does this use?
Base (Ethereum L2) — secure, inexpensive, and fast.

Are any fees hidden?
No. A mint costs exactly $15. Secondary sales include a visible flat royalty of $10.

What occurs when I sell my NFT?
The new buyer receives the book, the mint number (which becomes their referral code), all earned badges, and any active prize tickets; expired tickets remain expired.

How can I distribute my referral link/code?
From the Dashboard, copy the complete link, or copy only your mint number and tell people “use referral 423”.

Is this a scam or a pyramid scheme?
No. It operates on a single-level only. The full source is verified on Basescan. I receive $4 from every sale forever (minus any fiat fees), and my cut is the same for mints and secondary sales. Everything else funds commissions and prize pools.

How can I reach support?
There is no Discord yet (it will launch once we have real traction).
For the time being:
DM [HANDLE_001] on X
or
email [EMAIL_002]

If you still have questions, DM [HANDLE_001] on X or email [EMAIL_002] — I’m happy to assist.
